DECISION 01 / 08

24 September 2026

A hand-drawn storybook

Direction selected

Vero asked for a cute, hand-drawn cutaway seen from an elevated side view. It replaced the original static isometric office direction.

The room became a place to walk through, with layered scenery. The artwork shown here records that early change; it is not the latest room.

DECISION 02 / 08

24 September 2026

Different places, different rooms

Direction revised

The apartment and JPMorgan Chase could not share a backdrop. One was a compact home with a kitchen island, a pond-facing balcony, and side-by-side desks.

The internship happened in a closet. Full-time work later had its own cubicle. The settings needed to preserve those differences.

Source & art credits
  • Source: the project decision log and setting brief, 24 September 2026.
  • Generated with the built-in image-generation tool. The underlying raster model was not recorded.

DECISION 03 / 08

24 September 2026 · later revisions noted

Recognizable people and cats

Direction revised

Vero’s avatar needed her long dark hair and glasses. Lumi and Luci needed distinct black-and-white markings: Lumi has more white; Luci has more black.

Later, Vero rejected cat rigs that looked generic. The newer intact drawings remained candidates; the Fortress integration used the existing homepage kitten poses. A clean rig was not enough if it lost their identity.

Source & art credits
  • Source: the project decision log and setting brief, 24 September 2026.
  • Generated with the built-in image-generation tool. The underlying raster model was not recorded.
  • Later cat feedback has no separately recorded date here. Candidate review did not establish human approval.

DECISION 04 / 08

24 September 2026

Floating islands and a paper traveler

Implemented locally

Vero asked for a vertical map of floating career islands, connected by a path. A paper-cutout Vero travels along it as the visitor scrolls.

The map is another way to enter each chapter. Scroll progress never unlocks career information, and Quick View stays available.

DECISION 05 / 08

24 September 2026 · art revised 26 September

Fortress was a home den

Direction revised

Vero worked from home. A corporate office was the wrong setting for Fortress.

The den needed the backyard, a large tree, and wildlife beyond the window. A later art pass brought it closer to the other storybook rooms. These images precede the white-wall, two-desk revision.

Source & art credits
  • Source: recorded setting review, 24 September; matching-style revision, 26 September 2026.
  • The archive preserves historical pixels, not an approval record for every image.
  • Exact historical model attribution is not inferred.

DECISION 06 / 08

Trial: 26 September · rejection recorded 27 September 2026

Depth alone was not enough

Not selected

A geometric proof tested depth, movement, and occlusion. Vero rejected it as the visual benchmark, so a trial with separately illustrated objects followed.

That trial passed technical and visual agent checks, but Vero still found the decoration too sparse. The next attempt needed to preserve more of the room’s detail. The trial did not authorize a full-site migration.

Source & art credits
  • Source: trial and rejection recorded in the project decision log, 26–27 September 2026.
  • GPT-6 Astra directed the asset work. Built-in image generation produced the painted assets; code assembled the scene.
  • This spread contains a curated render only, not private reference photographs or raw benchmark records.

DECISION 07 / 08

28 September 2026

Two desks beneath the window

Implemented locally

Vero requested white walls, warmer acacia-like flooring, and two adjacent desks beneath a centered window. The tree moved to the left outdoors.

Levi has his own desk. He and the homepage kittens remain separate from the room artwork, so they can be positioned independently. Vero authorized integrating this room locally.

Source & art credits
  • Source: Vero’s layout correction and integration authorization, recorded 28 September 2026.
  • GPT-6 Astra directed the room artwork; built-in image generation produced the raster.
  • The original candidate manifest predates the later integration decision.

DECISION 08 / 08

28 September 2026

A recipe beside the café story

Implemented locally

Vero chose a cream-and-sage Quick View and asked for a recipe from the actual boba helper app. The reference supplied the presentation; the app supplied the quantities and steps.

The sample uses the established Strawberry Matcha Milk Tea recipe. Its fresh-milk alternative was marked as a draft. The drink image is an illustration, not a photograph of a café order.

Source & art credits
  • Source: Vero’s reference-led layout request, recorded 28 September 2026.
  • Drink illustration: GPT-6 Astra art direction; built-in image_gen.imagegen raster generation.
  • Local implementation and independent review are recorded; a separate final taste approval is not claimed.
